title: Water Sort Puzzle 3
seo_title: Water Sort Puzzle 3 — Play Free Water Sorting Game Online
meta_desc: Play Water Sort Puzzle 3 online free. Pour colored water between glasses until every glass holds one color in this relaxing liquid sorting game.
desc: Water Sort Puzzle 3 pours fresh levels into the classic liquid sorting formula. Each glass holds layered colors, and you can only pour water onto a matching top color or into an empty glass. Separate every hue into its own glass to clear the board.
howto: Tap a glass to pick up its top layer of water.
Tap a second glass to pour into it.
Water only flows onto the same top color or into empty space.
Finish when every glass contains a single color.
Use the undo button when a pour turns out to be a mistake.
tips: Keep one glass completely empty as breathing room for late-game reshuffles.
Isolate the color sitting at the bottom of the tallest glass first.
If two colors block each other everywhere, undo a few moves rather than restarting.
